name: dsh-audio-rail-macos
description: 让 DSH 会话页右侧的锚点跟着 Mac 上播放的音乐律动：12 段真实频谱，只改长度、不覆盖锚点原有状态。macOS 14.2+，首次运行需授予「音频录制」权限。

scripts.build:native: cd native && swiftc -O -parse-as-library -target arm64-apple-macos14.2 -o build/arm64 Sources/*.swift -framework CoreAudio -framework AudioToolbox -framework Accelerate && swiftc -O -parse-as-library -target x86_64-apple-macos14.2 -o build/x86_64 Sources/*.swift -framework CoreAudio -framework AudioToolbox -framework Accelerate && lipo -create -output bin/dsh-audio-rail-tap build/arm64 build/x86_64

author: Blueteemo <dinghongji0504@gmail.com>
